title: Ablation studies
outcome: Explain ablation studies using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Remove one component at a time. A retrieval pipeline has search plus a relevance filter. A team tests the filter’s contribution.
given: Full pipeline: 8/10 correct. Filter removed: 6/10 on the same cases, with all other settings fixed.

steps.label: Name the component
steps.detail: The relevance filter is the single declared change.

steps.label: Run the ablation
steps.detail: Remove only the filter and preserve cases and scoring.

steps.label: Compare outcomes
steps.detail: Correctness falls from 80% to 60%, two cases in this set.

explanation: An ablation probes a component by removing or changing it while holding the rest fixed. It supports a scoped comparison, not a claim that the component always helps.

counterfactual.change: Remove the filter and also change the model version.
counterfactual.prediction: The comparison no longer isolates the filter.
counterfactual.reason: Two simultaneous changes provide alternative explanations.

student_task: Calculate the filter ablation’s two rates and count change. Which single component is altered, and why does also changing the model prevent isolating the filter?
teacher_answer: The relevance filter is the single declared change. Remove only the filter and preserve cases and scoring. Correctness falls from 80% to 60%, two cases in this set. Changed case: The comparison no longer isolates the filter. Two simultaneous changes provide alternative explanations.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: Interactions and small-sample variability remain; this illustrative difference is not a universal causal estimate.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
